products.title: Wilson Endure Pro V1 2026 - Momo González - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ - A new era is about to begin with this jewel from Wilson Padel. Momo González's shovel. Intended for players who want the best control in their game. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL 

We present to you the most special Wilson Padel racket of the entire season, the WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ model, a racket with total maneuverability. It is Momo González's own model. If you are a fan of the round shape, this is yours. Its format will help us a lot to achieve a safe game from any area of ​​the court.

PLAYER TYPE

This racket is intended for players who want control over the ball, although it gives us a lot of power, thanks to its materials, it is a racket with 100% control, with a perfect round format and an ideal low balance.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The new WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ has materials that make it special. Deep work has been done on it to offer a completely new racket, with unique materials. On the planes, it incorporates unidirectional 3K carbon fiber. This new carbon treatment offers extra flexibility and much more resistance.

Inside, it incorporates dual-density foam called Control Foam, which improves the connection with the ball. This type of material offers incredible control over the ball.

One of the technologies it offers us is its double and reinforced Y-BEAM bridge, which helps us achieve better balance and reduce vibrations. It is a great padel racket to reduce arm discomfort.

ENEBE MUSTANG 12K BLUE 2025. Una de las palas más altas de gama de Enebe, con diseño muy cuidado y rugosidad en las caras.

 INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

La ENEBE MUSTANG 12K BLUE 2025 nos ofrece una herramienta de juego fabricada completamente en carbono, con una estética refinada de color nregro con detalles en azul eléctrico y plata. 

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Debido a su tacto, goma y balance será muy bien valorada entre los jugadores avanzados, ya que les ayudará enormemente tanto en golpes de defensa como de ataque. 

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

Esta Enebe llama la atención tanto por su apariencia como por su comportamiento en pista. Los materiales para su fabricación han sido elegidos con mucho cariño para producir una pala espectacular. El carbono utilizado para las caras es de primera calidad 12K, dando la sensacion de robustez y amortiguacion intermedia. Encontramos rugosidad para los que busquen jugar con mucho efecto. La goma incluida en su interior es la Black EVA HR7 high rebound, la cual proporciona una excelente respuesta al golpeo de la bola. Encontramos la pala con un balance medio alto, muy útil para el juego aéreo y los golpeos agresivos. La forma de la pala es de lágrima, ofreciendo buen punto dulce ligeramente desplazado hacia arriba.

ESTILO DE JUEGO

Esta Mustang 12K BLUE sale al mercado para satisfacer a jugadores que llevan mucho jugando y buscan una pala que les ayude a definir los puntos en la red y sacar con facilidad las bolas desde atrás.
products.englishTitle: Enebe Mustang 12k Blue 2025 - Bullpadel
products.englishDescription:
ENEBE MUSTANG 12K BLUE 2025. One of Enebe's highest range padel rackets, with a very careful design and roughness on the faces.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The ENEBE MUSTANG 12K BLUE 2025 offers us a gaming tool made entirely of carbon, with a refined black aesthetic with details in electric blue and silver. 

PLAYER TYPE

Due to its feel, rubber and balance, it will be highly valued among advanced players, as it will help them enormously in both defensive and attacking shots. 

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

This Enebe attracts attention both for its appearance and for its behavior on the track. The materials for its manufacture have been chosen with great care to produce a spectacular padel racket. The carbon used for the faces is top quality 12K, giving the sensation of robustness and intermediate cushioning. We find roughness for those looking to play with a lot of spin. The rubber included inside is Black EVA HR7 high rebound, which provides excellent response when hitting the ball. We find the padel racket with a medium-high balance, very useful for the aerial game and aggressive hits. The shape of the blade is teardrop, offering a good sweet spot slightly displaced upwards.

PLAY STYLE

This Mustang 12K BLUE comes on the market to satisfy players who have been playing for a long time and are looking for a racket that helps them define the points on the net and easily get the balls from behind.
